concerns.text: The plan specifies paired t‑tests on F1‑score vectors for (1) GCN vs. RF, (2) GCN vs. XGB, and (3‑7) each of the top‑5 structural features vs. the null baseline. It is unclear how a ‘structural feature’ alone constitutes a model to generate F1‑scores; the description lacks a concrete modeling pipeline (e.g., a classifier using only that feature) and thus the hypothesis test may not be well‑defined, threatening construct validity and the ability to answer FR‑006.
